description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_DB_Distributed, which manages distributed database connections with singleton pattern, DSN generation, and driver options, specifically for a master/slave database setup in the Openads (Revive Adserver) project.

classes.name: OA_DB_Distributed
classes.description: A class for using distributed stats with master/slave database setup inside Openads, extending OA_DB, providing singleton connection, DSN, and driver options.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton database connection resource, optionally with custom DSN and driver options.

methods.name: getDsn
methods.description: Generates and returns the default Data Source Name (DSN) string based on configuration.

methods.name: getDsnOptions
methods.description: Returns driver-specific options such as SSL and compression based on configuration.
